address: Grasweg 41S, Amsterdam-Noord (Buiksloterham): 2010 grey-clad industrial block 36 m high with a curved eaves line and sparse small windows, mostly hidden by trees
notes: Grasweg 41S (BAG, 2010; Buiksloterham, Noord): a 36 m grey metal-clad industrial block with a curved eaves line and low annexes (6.9-8.9 m) to the west. The panoramas show it only through tree cover and over a blue site fence: w01-349 (north, 22 m away) is all foliage, w05-80 (east, 34 m, 20 degree obliquity) shows the grey cladding with a few small windows under a curved cap, w08-349 shows the low annex behind the fence.

walls[0] = panel 45 (E, 24.6 m, party 6.9 m below): the grey cladding with small windows in three rows, drawn as 9 storeys x 4 bays of low windows with the other storeys blank (render/stone material grey). Every other wall is blank grey (palette brick set to the cladding grey) and the flat roof is bitumen. Simplified: the curved cap on the eaves line (straight in 3DBAG), the horizontal cladding ribs, the window positions (read from one oblique photo).
Not drawn or not seen: the north, south and west walls (tree cover) and the annexes.
